files.Dockerfile:
FROM debian:bookworm-slim
ARG START_PORT=7310
ENV HTTP_PORT=${START_PORT}
WORKDIR /srv
COPY bin/entrypoint.sh /srv/entrypoint.sh
COPY bin/server.sh /srv/server.sh
ENTRYPOINT ["bash", "/srv/entrypoint.sh"]
files.compose.yml:
services:
  web:
    build:
      context: .
      args:
        START_PORT: "7468"
    env_file:
      - deploy/web.env
    environment:
      HTTP_PORT: "7589"
